name: Maine

response.rule_text: Agency must confirm receipt within five working days with a good-faith, nonbinding time and cost estimate, and must deny within five working days of receipt; records must be provided within a reasonable time, 1 M.R.S.A. § 408-A.

fees.labor_rule: Actual cost of searching, retrieving and compiling, not more than $15 per hour after the first hour of staff time per request.
fees.copy_rule: Reasonable fee to cover the cost of copying (1 M.R.S.A. § 408-A).
fees.waiver_rule: Agency may waive all or part of a fee if requester is indigent or release is in the public interest.

residency.rule_text: The status of the requester is not relevant to the right to inspect and copy, 1 M.R.S.A. § 408-A.

appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; an informal complaint may go to the Attorney General's FOAA ombudsman (5 M.R.S.A. § 200-I) who cannot issue binding rulings. Appeal to court must be brought within 30 days after denial, 1 M.R.S.A. § 409.

notes: Governor covered (executive-branch records). Legislature covered, but legislative working papers, drafts and internal memoranda excluded.
